notes_for_editor: The 1963 date rests on one site. The Commons caption (the photographer's own description) says the tower was previously the Peet tower about 30 miles south, but gives no date for the move and no source found for the Peet tower. A search for the Peet tower returned nothing relevant, so no relocated event is written (year unknown). The story says the 1963 date may or may not refer to the current site. Record agency 163N-33-19 is printed in the Central page header as a bare code with no agency named; it looks like a land-survey location code. Not changed here; editor to check. No access or staffing source found.
